subject: CartWave trial — evaluation redesign, ownership, and acceptance checks
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom@cartwave.com>, Sofia Mendes <sofia@cartwave.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 13:04:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + next steps from today's discovery call — trial plan proposal attached

Hi Tom / Sofia —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we finalize the trial plan. I attached a draft trial plan (CartWave_trial_plan_v2.xlsx) with timelines and owners — see highlights below.

Summary of what we discussed:
- Goal: validate Redwood inference for CartWave’s conversational post-purchase flows (refund extraction + order-status escalations) and routing accuracy for policy-based replies. Primary success metrics are precision/recall on refund extraction and 95th percentile latency under 300ms for chat routing.
- Baseline dataset: 6k anonymized post-purchase transcripts from Jan–Mar 2027 (you confirmed delivery by Fri 6/3).
- Core use cases proposed for the POC:
  1) Refund reason & amount extraction (structured fields) — primary
  2) Order-status intent routing (escalate to ops or self-serve) — secondary
  3) Two-shot agent-assist snippets for agents (optional, low-priority)

Ask from Redwood: please confirm the baseline dataset delivery date and whether the team is open to adding one additional use case (see Tom’s note below from the call).

Proposed timeline (attached has details):
- Kickoff & data exchange: week of 6/7
- Ingest & initial run: 6/14–6/21
- Iteration and evaluation: 6/22–7/5
- Acceptance review and decision: by 7/12

Next steps / owners (please reply to confirm):
- CartWave: deliver dataset + test keys (Tom)
- Redwood: ingest + initial model baseline + evaluation plan (Dev)
- CartWave+Redwood: align acceptance criteria and labelled sample set (Chloe)

Attachments: CartWave_trial_plan_v2.xlsx, CartWave_usecase_inventory.csv

If you’re good with the above I’ll circulate an updated plan with explicit acceptance checks and have Dev scope the work.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
--
Redwood Inference | redwood.com
From: Tom Alvarez <tom@cartwave.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>, Sofia Mendes <sofia@cartwave.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 16:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today's discovery call — trial plan proposal attached

Aisha —

Thanks for the thorough recap. Quick confirmation and one ask from our side:

1) Dataset delivery looks good — I’ll send the export by Friday (6/3).
2) We want to add a small mid-trial scope change: include a use case for automated refund eligibility flagging (binary yes/no) that’s derived from the extracted fields + rules. It’s a light-weight add but important for our ops owners.

If that’s feasible without changing the overall timeline, please go ahead. I see Dev and Chloe are cc'd — happy to coordinate sample labeling with your team.

Also, we’ll have procurement look at the contract redlines next week — I’ll loop in our legal contact separately.

Tom
Head of Customer Ops | CartWave
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Recap + Tom request — proposed mid-trial scope add (refund eligibility flag)

Team — forwarding Tom's note. He asked to add a small use case mid-trial: refund eligibility flagging (binary) derived from extraction + simple rules. Can we scope this without pushing the acceptance date?

Proposed internal re-baseline (please comment inline in the attached plan):
- Add use case: Refund eligibility flag (outputs: eligible: yes/no, rule-trigger tag)
- Acceptance criteria (draft):
  • Extraction: field-level precision >= 88% and recall >= 80% on a 500-sample holdout for refund reason & amount
  • Eligibility flag: accuracy >= 85% on a 200-sample labeled set
  • Latency: 95th pct <= 350ms (inference path with caching)
  • Stability: no more than 2% failure rate on ingestion during evaluation window
- Timeline tweak: shift iteration window by 3 business days to incorporate eligibility rule engineering (new iteration window 6/25–7/8, acceptance review by 7/15)
- Owners: Dev (ingest + model baseline), Chloe (labeling coordination + acceptance dataset), Marcus (SRE/sla verification)

Dev / Marcus — can you confirm feasibility and whether the 3-day slip is sufficient? If it threatens the broader timeline or contract milestones, flag and I’ll push back to Tom with options (compress iteration, reduce optional agent-assist, or extend acceptance date).

Thanks —
Aisha
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 June 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Recap + Tom request — proposed mid-trial scope add (refund eligibility flag)

Aisha / team —

Quick feasibility check after reviewing the attached trial plan and our capacity for the kickoff week: we can absorb the eligibility flag add with the proposed 3-business-day shift. Notes below and small changes to acceptance checks:

Plan adjustments (confirmed):
- Data ingest: still on track for 6/7 kickoff provided we receive the export by 6/3 as Tom confirmed.
- Implementation: build extraction + eligibility scoring as a single pipeline; deliver first-pass extractor by 6/18 and a rule-based eligibility baseline by 6/22.
- Evaluation: we will run the labeled holdouts through both ML extractor+rules and a conservative rule-only baseline to compare lift.

Updated acceptance criteria (finalized):
1) Refund extraction: precision >= 88%, recall >= 80% on 500-sample holdout (Chloe owns labeling & verification).
2) Eligibility flag: F1 >= 0.82 on 200-sample labeled set (we prefer F1 to balance precision/recall for ops).
3) Latency: 95th percentile <= 350ms on the combined extractor+eligibility path (Marcus to validate on dedicated test pool).
4) Ops stability: ingestion failure rate < 2% and no more than 3 infra retries per hour during peak tests.

Owners & contacts:
- Dev Patel (dev_patel@redwood.com): implementation + model baseline
- Chloe Martin (chloe_martin@redwood.com): labeling coordination + acceptance dataset
- Marcus Lin (marcus_lin@redwood.com): SRE / latency verification + test harness
- Tom Alvarez (tom@cartwave.com): dataset delivery + ops subject matter expert

Deliverables we will attach to the acceptance review:
- Evaluation report with per-field confusion matrices and aggregated metrics (PDF)
- Playback of sample runs + inference traces (links)
- Labeled verification set snapshot (CSV)

If that looks good I’ll update the trial_plan_v2 and send a versioned plan (v2.1) to Tom and legal for contract alignment.

Thanks —
Dev
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
